literal_meaning: এক কথা বলার মানুষ (a person who speaks one word)
figurative_meaning_en: a person of few words or taciturn
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এককথার মানুষ, কখনো অযথা কথা বলে না।
গ্রামের বুড়ো এককথার মানুষ হয়ে উঠেছে বয়সের সাথে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a man of few words and never speaks unnecessarily.
The village elder has become a man of few words with age.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural value placed on restraint in speech in Bengali society.
